reference_sql:
WITH camp AS (
  -- one row per campaign with spend in October 2025
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.campaign_id
)
SELECT channel_id, campaign_id, spend_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id ORDER BY spend_eur DESC, campaign_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
    / SUM(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id), 1) AS cumulative_share_pct
FROM camp
alternatives:
WITH camp AS (
  -- one row per campaign with spend in October 2025
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.campaign_id
)
SELECT k.channel_id, k.campaign_id, k.spend_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(k2.spend_eur) FROM camp k2
                 WHERE k2.channel_id = k.channel_id
                   AND (k2.spend_eur > k.spend_eur OR (k2.spend_eur = k.spend_eur AND k2.campaign_id <= k.campaign_id)))
    / (SELECT SUM(k3.spend_eur) FROM camp k3 WHERE k3.channel_id = k.channel_id), 1) AS cumulative_share_pct
FROM camp k

WITH camp AS (
  -- one row per campaign with spend in October 2025
  SELECT c.channel_id, a.campaign_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, a.campaign_id
), totals AS (
  -- one row per channel
  SELECT channel_id, SUM(spend_eur) AS channel_eur
  FROM camp
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT k.channel_id, k.campaign_id, k.spend_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(k.spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY k.channel_id ORDER BY k.spend_eur DESC, k.campaign_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / t.channel_eur, 1) AS cumulative_share_pct
FROM camp k
JOIN totals t ON t.channel_id = k.channel_id
